content:
Summer deals are somehow still live on AirPods Pro 3 at $50 off alongside all-time low pricing on AirTag 2, but today we have some fresh discounts on Apple Watch Ultra 3. Amazon is now offering several configurations at nearly $100 off the list prices to join refreshed Series 11 offers from $299. We also have Anker’s more powerful 100W 3-port Smart Display Charger down at $50 on Amazon (nearly 30% off) and the Best Buy’s updated August Back to School sale – Apple gear, smart TVs from $80, dorm upgrades, and more. Scope it all out down below.

July summer deals on current-gen AirPods still live: AirPods Pro 3, Max 2, and more still up to $100 off

  • AirPods Pro 3 $200 (Reg. $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $449 (Reg. $549)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (Reg. $129)
  • AirPods 4 with ANC $145 (Reg. $179)
  • AirPods 4 with ANC $119 (Reg. $179 new) – Renewed Premium

AirTag 2 Black Friday in July all-time low pricing is still live ($22 each)

  • AirTag 2 $27 (Reg. $29)
  • AirTag 2 (4-pack) $89 (Reg. $99)

Black and Natural Titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 models now nearly $100 off at Amazon

Update: As we suspected, Amazon has also now dropped the price on a few other Ultra 3 configurations, including the Natural case model with the Anchor Blue Ocean Band at nearly $100 off. Details below.

While we have had a steady run of deals across the Series 11 lineup, much like we are right now to kick off August, deals on Apple Watch Ultra 3 have been much more rare. This morning, however, we spotted the black Ultra 3 with the black one size fits just about everyone Ocean band at nearly $100 off courtesy of Amazon.

Amazon is now offering the Apple Watch Ultra 3 in Black Titanium with the matching Black Ocean Band down at $699.99 shipped.

Regularly $799, this is just shy of $100 off the list price and the best deal we can find in brand new condition from a reputable retailer.

Outside of a brief Amazon Prime Day deal price at $150 off, this is on par with the best deals of the year and one of less than a handful of times we have tracked notable savings opportunities at Amazon.

As of the time of writing, the black model with the Ocean Band is the only configuration catching a solid discount. But if this deal is anything like last go around, we might very well see additional color configurations dropping in price today and throughout the week.

Update:

  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 w/ Black Ocean Band $700 (Reg. $799)
  • Natural Apple Watch Ultra 3 w/ Anchor Blue Ocean Band $700 (Reg. $799)
  • Natural Apple Watch Ultra 3 w/ Blue Trail Loop $700 (Reg. $799)
  • Natural Apple Watch Ultra 3 w/ Milanese Loop $800 (Reg. $899)

If it’s the Series 11 you’re after, you can score one of those for a whole lot less than this right now:

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 $299 (Reg. $399)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 $329 (Reg. $429)

Most affordable Apple Watch Series 11 models now $100 off again starting from $299

Amazon is carrying over summer sale pricing on AirPods Pro 3 into August, alongside the all-time low on AirTag 2, but it has also brought back the deals on just about all of the most popular (and affordable) Apple Watch Series 11 models at $100 off with deals starting from $299.

Amazon is now once again offering all of the base GPS-only Apple Watch Series 11 models at $100 off the list prices with the 42mm model down at $299 and the 46mm model at $329.

These are the same deals we were tracking for the summer Prime Day festivities, and then again at various times in July, but you are getting another shot at them again here today. As of the time of writing, only the base GPS-only models are seeing notable discounts – there are some offers on the GPS + Cell variants but they are, by and large, not sitting down low enough for us to recommend pulling the trigger

It appears as though Amazon is having a hard time keeping the base 42mm Jet Black in stock right now, but it does also look like there’s a good chance it will return at anytime now – all 46mm colors options are in stock at $100 off.

Apple’s official refurb store has the best deals on M5 MacBook Air, now up to $240 off

The official Apple Certified Refurbished Store is delivering the lowest price on M5 MacBook Air right now. Pricing on the base model M5 13-inch recently went up, but you can score one directly from Apple with a full 1-year warranty down at $1,099 shipped – you can’t even get an open-box model from the big retailers at a price this low – and you’ll other configurations at up to $240 off the list price directly from Apple.

Anker’s more powerful 100W 3-port Smart Display Charger is down at $50 on Amazon (Nearly 30% off)

Best Buy has now updated and launched a new August Back To School Sale event. Alongside the usual Deals of the Day offers, Best Buy has now updated its main sale page with a series of new offers on everything from laptops and Apple gear to smart TVs, dorm-ready coolers and fridges, Galaxy tablets, and more.

Today’s accessories and charging deals:

  • Aulumu A11 Apple Watch Band with metal Mag Buckle now 50% off at Amazon, score one for $20
  • Lexar’s 2TB magnetic iPhone SSD just dropped $130 to hit lowest price since the hike
  • Samsung’s $700 M8 Smart Monitor with built-in webcam is 50% off today at $350
  • Sharge’s new transparent metal 24000mAh power bank with RGB smart display lands at $50 off (Launch deal)
  • Tested: Hands-on with UGREEN’s new Nexode Pro 160W Smart display 4-port charger – Powerful and functional [Deal]
  • This 7,000mAh power bank doubles as wall charger with built-in plug and USB-C cable at just $28 today
  • Grab four breathable sport bands for your Apple Watch while they’re only $2.50 a pop

Latest MacBook Pro configs up to $500 off this week: Base M5 Max, 2TB M5 Pro, more

We are still tracking up to $500 off the list prices on M5 Pro MacBook Pro models, but if you’re looking to take it up a notch Amazon is also offering a major $500 price drop on the 36GB M5 Max MacBook Pro right now as well.

Amazon has the 14-inch M5 Max MacBook Pro with 36GB of RAM and the 2TB storage capacity down at $3,599 shipped right now.

This is the 18-core CPU and 32-core GPU base model M5 Max – the most affordable model you can buy at a giant $500 off the list price right now now. This deal is live on both the Space Black and Silver colorways.

Now clearly, despite being the entry M5 Max we are still talking about a pricey machine here. But this is also Apple’s most powerful chip with a 32-Core GPU (the base M5 Pro machines have a 16-Core GPU). It’s certainly not for everyone, but we wanted to make sure these deal was on the radar for anyone who might be looking towards one of these beast mode MacBooks this summer.

For the rest of, there are plenty of solid discounts live on the far more affordable MacBook Pro machines this week:

  • 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro 16GB/1TB $1,849 (Reg. $1,999)
  • 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro 24GB/1TB $2,044 (Reg. $2,199)
  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/1TB $2,260 (Reg. $2,499)
  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB $2,499 (Reg. $2,999) – $500 off
  • 16-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 48GB/1TB $3,378 (Reg. $3,599)
  • 16-inch M5 Max MacBook Pro 48GB/1TB $3,999 (Reg. $4,399)

Amazon’s best quality renewed iPhone 17 Pro units are $220 off, 17 Pro Max up to $450 off

Amazon launches summer Ring doorbell sale at up to 38% off with deals from $50 on latest models

Alongside a host of discounts on ultra-affordable Blink smart home gear, Fire TV streaming sticks, and tech for the kids, Amazon is also now offering up to 38% off a series of the latest Ring smart doorbell releases starting from $50.

  • Ring Wired Doorbell Pro from $200 (Reg. $250)
  • Ring Wired Doorbell $50 (Reg. $80)
  • Ring Battery Doorbell $70 (Reg. $100)
  • Ring Battery Doorbell Plus $120 (Reg. $180)
  • And even more…

Joining the 30% price drop on the latest Retinal 2K Battery wireless model, Amazon is now offering the newest Ring Wired Doorbell Pro down at $199.99 shipped.

Regularly $250 for the classic Deep Silver model, this is $50 off the list price and best we can find. You’ll also find $50 price drops live on the other three colors that carry list prices at between $260 and $265.

Ring Wired Doorbell Pro delivers Retinal 4K video coverage of your front porch with up to 10x zoom, the ability to hear and speak to visitors without opening the door, and “true color, even in low light.” You’ll also land 3D Motion Detection that “pinpoints motion on your property so you’ll receive more precise alerts and fewer interruptions.”

Scope out our launch coverage from last September for more details.
